ticker: Borr Drilling rig sinks off Gabon, five missing
Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drones and missiles
Cyclone threat prompts severe weather warnings in India
UK issues preparedness advice amid cyber and weather risks
ISRO to expand space operations with four new launch pads

articles.headline: Borr Drilling Rig Sinks Off Gabon Coast
articles.brief: A Borr Drilling rig has sunk off the coast of Gabon, leaving five personnel missing. Search and rescue operations are currently underway to locate the crew members as maritime authorities investigate the cause of the sudden offshore accident.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Drones and Missiles
articles.brief: Saudi military forces successfully intercepted multiple drones and missiles targeting the kingdom amid ongoing hostilities with Yemen's Houthi movement. Authorities have advised nationals in the region to exercise extreme caution and refrain from filming incoming strikes.

articles.headline: UK Urges Citizens to Stockpile Essentials
articles.brief: The UK government has launched the 'Be Ready' campaign, urging households to stockpile three days of food and water. Officials cited growing concerns over potential cyberattacks, extreme weather events, and infrastructural disruptions.

articles.headline: Severe Cyclone Threat Looms Over Bay of Bengal
articles.brief: The Indian Meteorological Department has issued red alerts as a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal intensifies into a severe cyclonic storm. Landfall is expected near the Andhra coast, bringing heavy rainfall and destructive winds across multiple states.

articles.headline: Audi to Invest $4.2 Billion in First US Factory
articles.brief: Automotive giant Audi has announced a $4.2 billion investment to establish its first manufacturing plant in Georgia, United States. The facility aims to produce 200,000 SUVs annually and generate thousands of local jobs by the early 2030s.

articles.headline: ISRO Plans Four Launch Pads by 2029
articles.brief: The Indian Space Research Organisation has clarified that the agency will not be privatised while outlining ambitious expansion plans. ISRO aims to operate four functional launch pads by 2029 through strategic private sector partnerships.

articles.headline: GST Appellate Tribunal Rules on Cancelled Flight Tickets
articles.brief: In a notable ruling, the GST Appellate Tribunal has determined that airlines can claim tax refunds on cancelled flight tickets provided they issue full refunds of fares and taxes to passengers with adequate documentation.

articles.headline: Goldman Sachs Predicts Luxury Goods Recovery in 2027
articles.brief: Financial analysis from Goldman Sachs suggests the global luxury goods industry is on track for a meaningful recovery by 2027. The United States is projected to remain a major bright spot for high-end retail performance.

articles.headline: NCERT Introduces AI Module for Classes 9 to 12
articles.brief: The National Council of Educational Research and Training has rolled out a comprehensive 20-hour artificial intelligence and computational thinking module. The curriculum is tailored for high school students to enhance foundational tech skills.

articles.headline: Johnson & Johnson Cancer Drug Shrinks Tumors
articles.brief: Early-stage clinical trial results indicate that Johnson & Johnson's novel prostate cancer drug effectively shrinks tumors. Medical professionals view the trial data as a promising development for advanced cancer therapies.

articles.headline: Cancer Immunotherapy Becomes More Affordable in India
articles.brief: Recent market adjustments have significantly lowered the cost of specific cancer immunotherapy treatments, bringing prices down from lakhs to a fraction. Healthcare advocates are monitoring whether patients will widely receive the financial benefits.

articles.headline: Disenchanted Voters Target of Israeli Election Campaign
articles.brief: Political campaigns in Israel are increasingly focusing on disillusioned supporters of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. These undecided voters are emerging as the ultimate prize for candidates vying for influence in the tightening political race.

articles.headline: China Names New Provincial Chiefs Ahead of Plenum
articles.brief: The Chinese Communist Party has appointed new provincial chiefs ahead of the upcoming fifth plenum. The strategic leadership reshuffle signals a consolidation of administrative control as top officials prepare for key policy sessions.

articles.headline: Karnataka All-Rounder Manvanth Kumar Shines in Domestic Cricket
articles.brief: Young cricketer Manvanth Kumar is making waves in domestic competitions with his stellar batting and bowling displays. Drawing inspiration from legendary players, the rising star reflects on his journey and ambitions in professional cricket.
